title: Replace Panda Cards app with a crypto short-analysis app (heuristic AI)

requirements.text: Replace the current “Panda Cards” product UI with a new app focused on analyzing cryptocurrencies for potential short opportunities, using English for all user-facing text.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: App no longer shows panda card collection, random card modal, or panda-specific copy.
Primary navigation/header branding reflects the new crypto short-analysis purpose.
All visible text is in English.

requirements.text: Create a new analysis workflow UI where a user can (a) enter a crypto identifier (e.g., symbol/name), (b) provide market data as pasted OHLCV rows or CSV text, and (c) run an analysis to produce a short/avoid short recommendation with a transparent score breakdown.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: There is a dedicated analysis form with inputs for asset identifier and pasted OHLCV/CSV data.
User can trigger an analysis and see a result panel with: recommendation (e.g., “Consider Short” / “Avoid Short”), overall confidence/score, and a breakdown of contributing signals.
The UI validates that the pasted data is parseable and shows a clear English error message when invalid.

requirements.text: Implement backend data models and endpoints for crypto analysis requests and results, including storing a per-user analysis history (keyed by caller principal) and returning the user’s past analyses.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to: submit an analysis request (asset + OHLCV series) and receive an analysis result; list the caller’s saved analysis history; fetch a specific past analysis by id.
Analyses are stored per-caller and cannot be read by other principals.
Backend returns stable, deterministic results for the same input series (no randomness).

requirements.text: Implement the “AI analyze” logic as an on-canister heuristic scoring engine (no external LLM): compute common technical indicators from the provided OHLCV series (at minimum RSI and moving averages) and derive a short-opportunity score plus human-readable reasons.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: Given an OHLCV series, backend computes RSI and at least one moving-average-based trend signal.
Backend outputs: overall score/confidence, recommendation label, and a list of English ‘reasons’ explaining which signals triggered.
If insufficient data length for indicators, backend returns a clear error describing the minimum required rows.

requirements.text: Connect the new frontend workflow to the backend using React Query (new hooks analogous to the existing query patterns), including loading, error, and empty states, and a history view showing previous analyses for the logged-in user.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: Running an analysis shows a loading state, then renders the returned result.
Errors from backend are surfaced in a readable English message.
A history section lists prior analyses (asset, timestamp, recommendation/score) and allows viewing details.

requirements.text: Add a prominent disclaimer in the UI stating the app provides informational analysis only and is not financial advice.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: Disclaimer text is visible in the main analysis experience (e.g., near results and/or footer).
Disclaimer is written in clear English and does not claim guaranteed outcomes.

requirements.text: Adopt a coherent new visual theme appropriate for a crypto analysis tool (avoid the current pink/purple/blue collectible-card aesthetic): a dark ‘trading terminal’ style with neutral grays and neon green/amber accents, consistent typography, and clear information hierarchy.

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: Header, buttons, and key metric highlights follow the new terminal-style palette (no dominant pink/purple/blue gradients).
Layouts prioritize readability of tables/metrics and analysis results.
Theme is applied consistently across analysis form, results, and history views.

requirements.text: Generate and include static brand assets for the new app (logo + simple icon) and render them from frontend static assets (not via the backend).

quotes: i wanna create new app wich can help me to ai analyze crypto to short

acceptanceCriteria: New generated images are added under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly in the UI.
Header displays the new logo/icon at appropriate sizes without layout shift.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not integrate external LLM/AI services (analysis must be implemented locally as heuristic/indicator-based).
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: No automated trade execution, brokerage exchange integration, or order placement.
No real-time streaming prices via WebSockets or push notifications.
No third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
No guarantee of profitability; the app must not present outputs as financial advice.

required: Minimal crypto/short-analysis app logo mark, dark terminal style with neon green/amber accents (crypto-short-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Simple monochrome app icon symbol suitable for small sizes, terminal style (crypto-short-icon.dim_128x128.png)
